hero.description: Connect your device, select your model and board version, and start flashing immediately. No setup required.

fastFlashing.title: Fast Flashing
fastFlashing.description: Flash your Nerd*axe in seconds, not minutes.

webBased.title: Web-Based
webBased.description: No need for special software. Use your web browser.

multipleBoards.title: Multiple Boards
multipleBoards.description: Support for various Nerd*axe boards and modules.

instructions.title: How to Use

steps.1: Connect your Nerd*axe to your computer.
steps.2: Click "Connect Device" and select your device from the popup.
steps.3: Select your device model from the dropdown.
steps.5: Click "Start Flashing" to begin the process.
steps.6: Wait for the flashing process to complete.

rustInfo.teaser: The firmware is now also available in Rust
rustInfo.title: The firmware, rewritten in Rust
rustInfo.intro: The complete firmware has been ported from C/C++ to Rust. Rust is a modern systems language whose compiler catches whole classes of bugs before the code ever runs on your miner.

memorySafety.title: Memory safe.
memorySafety.description: Buffer overflows, null pointer dereferences and use-after-free bugs are ruled out by the compiler instead of crashing your device.

bugsFixed.title: Dozens of bugs fixed.
bugsFixed.description: Porting the code turned up bugs in the C version, including crashes and security issues. 36 of them are fixed in the Rust version.

sameFeatures.title: Same features, same settings.
sameFeatures.description: Same web interface (AxeOS), same configuration. With "Keep configuration" your settings stay as they are.

switchBack.title: Switch back anytime.
switchBack.description: Changed your mind? Flash the C/C++ version again right here.
